prerequisites: Appropriate application of fundamental knowledge of electrical machines

learning_outcomes.text: Adequate application of knowledge on the construction of electrical machines, knowledge of their operation, knowledge of electromagnetic and mechanical phenomena specific to electrical machines, electromechanical, electrical equipment and electromechanical drives

Description of the principles of operation of single and three-phase transformers, of direct current electrical machines, of asynchronous and synchronous electrical machines. Understanding and explaining electrical and electronic equipment containing electrical machines
Explanation and interpretation of the operating regimes of electrical machines, of the electrical and electromechanical equipment of which they are part.
Identification of electromechanical systems according to their composition; mathematical modeling, as well as their kinematic and dynamic description
Identification of the objectives to be achieved, available resources, conditions to complete them, working stages, working times, associated deadlines and risks

Acquiring information and knowledge on: the place and role of electrical machines in current and modern industry; construction, behavior, structure and operation of electrical machines in a complex system; organization, endowment and maintenance of the systems of which the electrical machines are part.

The laboratory works acquaint the students with the practical aspects regarding the operation of electrical machines, with practical aspects regarding the establishment of specific regimes in the laboratory (starting, braking, changing the speed) and ensure the understanding of the basic problems regarding these equipments of the electrical industry.

syllabus_topics: Asynchronous linear motor with short inductor
The mechanical characteristic of the MAL
The principle of operation of the two-phase asynchronous servo motor.
Equivalent diagram of the three-winding transformer
Simplified phasor diagram of the three-winding transformer
Transformers for changing the number of phases
Transforming the three-phase system (m =3) into a two-phase system (m=2) of voltages
Changing the number of phases from m = 3 to m = 6
Changing the number of phases from m = 3 to m = 12
The use of electric amplifier machines in automatic regulation schemes
Block diagram of an automatic positioning system
The principle of operation of selsins
Equations in electromotive voltages, currents, magnetic fields with sinusoidal distribution in space
Selsins with contact rings and brushes
Concluding the course with a recapitulation of the studied theoretical aspects and preparing the details regarding the examination
Instructions for work safety technique and methodology for performing laboratory work.
Direct current generator with separate excitation. Operating characteristics
The three-phase asynchronous motor with the rotor in short circuit. Operating characteristics
Determination of groups of connections to the three-phase transformer
The no-load and short-circuit test of the three-phase transformer
Operation of the three-phase transformer under load
Verification of the acquired knowledge and conclusion of the situation at the laboratory. Recovery of laboratory work
teaching_methods: Presenting and handing out laboratory papers

assessment_methods.method: Oral examination (for students with written exam grade 7 or higher)
Laboratory test (recognition of stands for note 5, detailed knowledge of all lab work for note 10)
Grade for laboratory work during the semester and for the laboratory work file

assessment_rules: The final mark consists of a 70% written exam and a 30% laboratory evaluation. The written exam is divided into easy, medium, and difficult level subjects. Students who obtain a grade of 7 or higher on the written exam are entitled to take an oral examination. The laboratory evaluation involves a test on all laboratory work, with criteria for grades 5 and 10. Minimum performance standard includes description of transformer operating principles, basic knowledge of electrical machine construction and operation, explanation of operating modes, and proper use and monitoring of electromechanical systems.
